  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  April 24, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
meeting ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on April 24, 2025 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh , Administration Department
  Angel Leon – Martell, Planning Department – 2:01 p.m.
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Sgt.Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Boytrese Osias, Public Works Department – 2.01 p.m.
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services & Public Safety Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Synaelyn Thomas, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on April 10, 2025.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Daniel Medina on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Touch A Truck Event at 400 W Beach
  Ave; Rogers Park, Public Property on Saturday, May 3, 2025 from 11:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day event at Rogers Park; Event will be
  staffed with IPD personnel; IPD will attend event; None Code Enforcement Conditions; None
  additional recommendations for Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal
  Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No. 00405558)

Item #2:  Doris Obih on behalf of 40 Love Foundation to host a 40 Love x La Roche Posay Family Day
  Event at 700 Warren Ln; Edward Vincent Jr. Park – Donald Bly Tennis Complex, Public
  Property on Saturday, May 3, 2025 from 11:30 a.m. – 1:30 p.m APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day event at Edward Vincent Park; Applicant to hire
  adequate licensed-professional security guard(s) for the safety of attendees. Security

Item #4:  Anthony Harris on behalf of City of Inglewood to host an Annual Splish Splash – Water Safety
  Event at 700 Warren Ln; Edward Vincent Jr. Park – Swimming Pool Complex, Public Property
  on Saturday, May 17, 2025 from 11:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  Approval for 1 day event at Edward Vincent Park; IPD and City Hall security personnel will
  staff this event for public safety; Request for security staff will be via Public Safety Supervisor
  Emory Ward; None Code Enforcement Conditions; None additional recommendations for
  Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the
  end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by
  the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,

  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00405559)

Item #5:  Camille Delaney McNeil on behalf of Los Angeles Philharmonic (YOLA) to host a YOLA
  Soiree 5.22.25/ YOLA at Inglewood Yammy’s Event at 101 S La Brea Ave; Beckman YOLA
  Center; on Thursday, May 22, 2025 from 7:00 p.m. – 9:00 p.m.; Friday, May 23, 2025 from
  2:00 p.m. – 8:00 p.m.;Private Property APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for 2 day
  event within YOLA parking lot; This event to be exclusively contained to private property, NO
  use of city streets, sidewalks or alleys (drop-off only in alley). Applicant to hire a minimum of
  five (5) professional-licensed security guards for the safety of attendees and two (2) security
  guards for the supervision; The IPD watch commander will be notified and extra patrol-high
  visibility will be provided as time permits;None additional recommendations for Fire approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the

Item #6:  Sidney Jackson Jr. on behalf of Phi Beta Sigma Frat Games to host a Community Softball
  Games Event at 3400 W Arbor Vitae St; Darby Park – Baseball Field (Big Field), Public
  Property; every Sunday of each month, from Sunday, June 15, 2025 – August 31, 2025, from
  2:00 p.m. – 6:00 p.m.; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY Approval for 12 day event at Darby
  Park; Applicant shall staff adequate professional-licensed security -OR- off-duty LE fraternity
  personnel for safety of attendees. IPD watch commander will be notified and extra patrol
  provided as time permits; None Code Enforcement Conditions; None additional
  recommendations for Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly
  cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event
  shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and
  Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00405486)

Item #7:  Adriana Ricketts on behalf of Morningside Monarch Alumni Association to host an Annual All
  Class Alumni Picnic - MHS Event at 700 Warren Ln; Edward Vincent Jr. Park; on Saturday,
  August 16, 2025; Public Property from 11:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.; APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY Approval for 1 day event at Edward Vincent Park; Applicant to hire
  adequate professional-licensed security guards for the safety of attendees and to monitor the
  restrooms to deter any outside lewd conduct activity; There shall be NO alcoholic beverages
  possessed, consumed at this event or in the park; None Code Enforcement Conditions; None
  additional recommendations for Fire approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working
  this event shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask
  wearing safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal
  Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No. 00405461)
